purpose: User-requested collection of recent Jev / System One / typed decision model papers from WeChat, Zhihu, Weibo and X/Twitter, run alongside the round-15 arXiv sweep.
recency: 2026-11-13 through 2026-11-15 (the days since the 11-13 round), with undated discovery queries for the surrounding week; paper first-submission dates are taken from arXiv records, not post dates.

queries.query: site:mp.weixin.qq.com Jev 决策模型 2026年11月
queries.result: no dated November hits (WeChat indexing limitation); ecosystem items only: Google's free-tier decision model, OpenAI's 100 ms fast-brain Decisions API for GPT-6 (10-23), Shanghai AI Lab 书生·明决 (Intern-Decision, open-sourced 09-28, claims above Jev)

queries.query: site:zhihu.com Jev 决策模型 System One 2026年11月
queries.result: columns still cluster in 2026-09/10; no November column found; new non-paper items: a JevLite Qwen3-4B replication post and a Mobius/ONNX local-deployment tutorial

queries.query: site:weibo.com Jev 决策模型 论文
queries.result: ttarticle explainers and funding news only; no new paper leads

queries.query: Jev decision model arxiv new paper November 13 14 15 2026
queries.result: surfaced 2611.15576 (survey probabilities), 2611.16321 (adaptive computation), 2611.17167 (actor/judge/teacher), 2611.15777 (SO-Arena) and AIM-Decision alongside already-catalogued records (2611.11480, 2611.10802, 2611.12521, Ru-Jev label wording, MedJev); all four new IDs were also caught independently by the round-15 API sweep

queries.query: AIM-Decision benchmark Jev Clef decision models arxiv 2611
queries.result: AIM-Decision is an AIMultiple analyst report (Tier B, updated 10-05, 'Jev vs Kev vs LLMs'), not an arXiv paper; a community fork (Oscar-dzy/Awesome-jev-papers) lists it; non-paper item

queries.query: "Can Decision Models Speed Up Agentic RAG" arxiv
queries.result: resolves to a Medium article (Corpus2Skill/DecisionRAG: mean end-to-end latency 49.73 to 18.67 s over 200 questions, 6,221 documents), not an arXiv record; non-paper lead

queries.query: "Actor, Judge, or Teacher" decision models arxiv Jev
queries.result: resolved to 2611.17167 (ZJU/Baidu; JEV as GRPO teacher on ALFWorld/WebShop); also caught by the API sweep; Rohan Paul X-thread coverage of the 42.9%-actor-yet-good-teacher finding; the underlying news story ('AI model that's bad at a task can still train another AI') is coverage of the same paper
resolved to 2611.15777 (11 domains, five capability families, 21 System One models incl. Jev API 1.14); also caught by the API sweep; Hugging Face daily-papers pickup

queries.query: "From Questions to Decisions" PRISM Sarvam arxiv decision model
queries.result: 2611.13015 is Ask2Decide (LLM clarification benchmark) - screened out this round; Sarvam Prism launched 11-03 as an open-weight decision model on the Sarvam 105B base (44 ms answers, first in speed among 25 tested) but still has no arXiv report; an aggregator pointer to 2611.13563 is an unrelated edge-NPU benchmarking paper

queries.query: 上海AI实验室 书生·明决 决策模型 arxiv 技术报告
queries.result: no arXiv technical report for 书生·明决/Intern-Decision (0.8B/2B/4B open-source, multimodal 'see and decide', launched 09-28); stays a watch lead - note Intern-Decision-4B is now evaluated inside two newly catalogued papers (2611.16321 NESTONE and 2611.16565 vulnerability harness)

queries.query: Sarvam Prism OR "Gemini Decisions" arxiv technical report decision model November 2026
queries.result: neither has an arXiv record yet (Prism blog 11-03 + weights; Gemini Decisions still API-only - Jev Daily 11-13 notes Hamilton Ulmer's HotdogBench puts Jev ahead of Gemini Decision 1)

published; no papers: 100-agent swarm gym atlas ($200, 6,823 gyms), Sydney Runkle's Slack agent gating replies with Jev, Hamilton Ulmer adding Gemini Decisions to HotdogBench (Jev still ahead, Claude Fable 5.2 fewest errors at highest cost)
published; no papers: Browser Use 1.0.4 cost drop ($0.67 to $0.45 per task via 96% cache hit), Allie the Icon's speculative-questions Jev batching pattern (state tokens paid once per call)

paper_leads.title: From Questions to Decisions: Benchmarking How LLM Agents Acquire Decision-Relevant Information from Human Beings
paper_leads.resolution: excluded - LLM planning/clarification benchmark with no Jev, System One or typed-decision content; the only ledger entry of its own for this social round

non_paper_leads.name: 书生·明决 / Intern-Decision (Shanghai AI Lab)
non_paper_leads.source: WeChat ecosystem coverage; shlab.org.cn news 5444306; open-sourced 2026-09-28
non_paper_leads.note: 0.8B/2B/4B open-weight multimodal decision model claiming performance above Jev; no arXiv technical report yet - watch lead alongside Prism/Vega/JEV-27B-VL/Gemini Decisions; Intern-Decision-4B already appears inside catalogued papers 2611.16321 and 2611.16565

non_paper_leads.name: AIM-Decision (AIMultiple)
non_paper_leads.note: independent analyst benchmark 'Jev vs Kev vs LLMs' (Jev 1.14 at 56.6, $0.036 per 1,000 decisions per coverage); not an arXiv record; non-paper item

non_paper_leads.name: Corpus2Skill/DecisionRAG
non_paper_leads.note: end-to-end evaluation of Jev inside an agentic RAG pipeline (200 questions, 6,221 documents; 49.73 to 18.67 s mean latency); blog/engineering report, not an arXiv paper

non_paper_leads.name: JevLite (Zhihu) / Mobius ONNX (Zhihu)
non_paper_leads.note: community Qwen3-4B replication post (64.5 ms per decision) and a local ONNX deployment tutorial; non-paper items

note: Four-platform round run alongside the round-15 arXiv sweep: the X/Twitter cross-check surfaced four new IDs (2611.15576, 2611.15777, 2611.16321, 2611.17167), all of which the round-15 arXiv API sweep also caught independently, so additions are credited to the sweep's screening. The social round's own ledger contribution is one exclusion: Ask2Decide (2611.13015, LLM clarification benchmark, no typed-decision content). Watch leads unchanged: Sarvam Prism, Vega, JEV-27B-VL, Gemini Decisions and 书生·明决/Intern-Decision all still lack arXiv records, though Intern-Decision-4B now appears inside two catalogued papers. Jev Daily 11-13 and 11-14 issues contain no papers.
